recent_en: EVD has had several recent corporate activities: conversion of redeemable preference shares into ordinary shares and listing, involving 723,225 shares and 4,000,000 shares; there were also winding-up/receivership related announcements and a material litigation announcement. There was also a boardroom change involving Norhizam bin Abdul Kadir.
notable_en: Conversion of redeemable preference shares into 723,225 new ordinary shares, with listing date on 2 Nov 2026.
Conversion of redeemable preference shares into 4,000,000 new ordinary shares, with listing date on 30 Oct 2025.
The company made announcements related to winding-up/receivership/restraining order/special administrator.
risks_en: The company made announcements related to winding-up/receivership/restraining order/special administrator; subsequent developments warrant attention.
The company made a material litigation announcement; litigation progress warrants attention.
Conversion of preference shares resulted in issuance of new shares, which may have a dilutive effect on existing shareholders' interests.
